sections.text:
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 200. Success value 70. 10x magic damage (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Constriction. The next Ability used will change from targeting all to a single target (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: all enemies. Removes attack Ability accuracy increasing effects.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 80. Confuses for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces status ailment resistance value by 50 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces healing received by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Recovers 25 Cost.
